sampling.note: Scored requests send no temperature, top_p or top_k. The evaluated model family rejects them: on Claude Sonnet 5 those parameters are removed and a request carrying one fails with HTTP 400, so a fixed temperature is not a control that exists to be set. Section 6.2 of the LLM Proficiency specification already allows this: it requires identical decoding controls OR the same recorded provider-controlled state for all languages. That state is recorded here and in the gateway audit log. Depth is pinned through output_config.effort instead, which is the control this model family actually exposes, and it is identical for every language.

llm_learnability.note: The primary counts are frozen before a run and apply identically to all languages. Extended replication is diagnostic and starts only after all primary evaluations are complete or blocked.

semantic_compression.assignment_preference: one worker handles a probe/group across all 10 languages

language_quality.quidra_program_root_note: Quidra benchmark programs (micro/, adversarial/) and the frozen Quidra type-binding amendment live in the evaluated snapshot under this path, maintained with the compiler and re-audited mechanically for every evaluated commit. They are never reused across commits from the template or from a previous run.

worker_isolation.network_policy: provider egress belongs to the trusted gateway only; the scored sandbox runs with no network namespace and reaches the gateway solely through the shared Unix socket
worker_isolation.packet_only_inference: benchmark.py task-infer via the same credential-less gateway
worker_isolation.trial_records: runtime-owned files under work/agents/<agent-id>/trials/, written verbatim by scripts/sandbox_agent.py and not writable by the worker
worker_isolation.prompt_caching: trusted-side, invisible to the sandbox, changes prefix cost only

task_spend_guard.note: Per-task soft ceiling enforced by the trusted gateway from the frozen task policy: max(floor, multiplier x the unit's planned token envelope). A unit that keeps spending past its plan is refused further inference and blocked, instead of consuming the run-wide budget on its own.
